correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=2 at the balanced critical parameter a=1/(2m), the stated two-dimensional full-branch map preserves Lebesgue measure. The horizontal symbols are iid fair alpha/beta choices and digits are independent uniform. Tracking common m-adic tails after pushes/pops gives Cov(Y0,Yn)=E[m^{-(S_n+2M_n)}]/12. The simple-walk reflection principle gives P(S_n+2M_n=r)=(r+1)(p_n(r)-p_n(r+2)), including n=0 and parity restrictions. The binomial resolvent sums to G(z)=(1+t(z)^2)/(12(1-t(z)/m)^2); its value at z=1 gives the Green–Kubo sum. The exact adjacent-binomial ratio and local CLT plus an m^{-r} geometrically dominated tail prove O_m(n^{-5/2}) after the parity-dependent n^{-3/2} constants, with strictly positive amplitude gap. Checked the finite distribution independently by enumerating all 2^n walks for n=0..10 and m=2,3,4 with rational weights, as well as inspectable independent Koopman/series checker source. These finite checks do not prove the asymptotic theorem.
